description: Warranty plan sold with the equipment on this account. Values: Standard 12 Months, Extended 36 Months, None. Read by the service desk to decide whether a repair is billed to the customer.
Highest unpaid invoice total allowed for this account, set by credit control at onboarding and reviewed each year. The order integration blocks new orders while the open balance is above this amount.
Checked when the carrier contract for this account's delivery address excludes hazardous goods. Orders containing items marked as hazardous are held for manual dispatch approval.
Number of calendar days since the date in Last_Invoice_Date__c, recalculated by formula each day. Accounts above 180 days move to the dormant-customer email programme.
Date on which this contact gave explicit consent to marketing emails, copied from the consent management platform. No marketing email is sent to EU contacts without a date here.

Highest forklift operator licence this contact holds, checked against the certificate by the account manager. Values: None, Counterbalance, Reach Truck, Instructor. Controls who may operate equipment at on-site demos.
Login name of this contact in the partner portal, in the format firstname.lastname. Written by the portal provisioning flow when access is granted; the single sign-on service matches it at login.

Checked when the buyer's IT security team has approved the product security questionnaire. Set by the sales engineer once written approval arrives. Required before the opportunity can move to the Contract stage.

Main reason the buyer declined this opportunity. Values: Price, Chose Competitor, No Budget, Project Cancelled, Missing Feature. Required when the stage is set to Closed Lost; feeds the quarterly win/loss review.
Reference to the Contact record of the person at the buyer who receives invoices for this deal. Copied to the order at Closed Won and sent to the billing system as the invoice recipient.

Firmware version installed on the customer's device when the case was opened, in the format major.minor.patch (e.g. 4.2.1). Read from the device telemetry feed and compared with the latest release before troubleshooting.

Cause of the failure, set by the support engineer after diagnosis. Values: Hardware Fault, Software Bug, Installation Error, Operator Error, Transport Damage. Must be set before the case can be closed.
